changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0
summary: Onboards a new player into Structs. Handles key creation/recovery, player creation (via reactor-infuse or guild signup), planet exploration, and initial infrastructure builds. Use when starting fresh, setting up a new agent, creating a player, claiming first planet, or building initial infrastructure. Build times range from ~17 min (Command Ship) to ~57 min (Ore Extractor/Refinery).
